models.name: Keyword Transformer KWT-1 (Speech Commands V2, 12 labels)
models.source: ARM-software/keyword-transformer (kws_streaming family), converted TFLite->ONNX by .github/workflows/build.yaml (module kws-streaming)
models.notes: ARM Keyword Transformer, 1 head. Sliding-window (non-streamable topology): 1 s window re-evaluated every 100 ms; the MFCC front-end is inside the graph (preprocess=raw, feature_type=mfcc_tf). Labels: _silence_/_unknown_/yes/no/up/down/left/right/on/off/stop/go. Upstream-reported top-1 97.61% (accuracy_last.txt); CI re-validated on real Speech Commands clips at 100.0% (120/120) argmax with silence -> _silence_ (build run 31385112437). sha256 is null and sizeBytes is nominal (rounded): tf2onnx output is not byte-reproducible across runs, so exact values would be wrong after any rebuild.
